description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of items across topic categories, showing 5 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages on the ring and correspond to a central legend titled “Topics”: “Moive” (light blue) at approximately 41.2%, an unlabeled/blank legend entry (light green) at approximately 14.9%, “Person” (light pink) at approximately 30.5%, “Book” (pale yellow) at approximately 9.1%, and “Sport” (light purple) at approximately 4.3%. A legend is placed in the center of the donut, and each slice has its percentage printed near the outer edge; no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering rule.
